items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: Ernie and I had kept a beautiful relationship all of our lives because he knew my children, I knew his children, I knew his wife and so forth.

ctx.x: No, no, no. That's a faster train. Let's go back. Let's go back for a second. So you worked at JBW. No. JBW, no. What was your further first station you went?

Well, after that, now, here comes WMRY, which is now WYLD. That's wild. WMRY started in the French Quarter by the Court of Two Sisters. Ernie Branger, who was Ernie the whip, he was the major black disc jockey down there. Well, Ernie and I had kept a beautiful relationship all of our lives because he knew my children, I knew his children, I knew his wife and so forth. Even his oldest child today still calls me his uncle. Well, anyway, Ernie and I were in high school together. So, Ernie said, why don't you come to…
Is Israel Augustine the same? He was a DJ?
